review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company GrabJobs is a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of the cybersecurity industry, renowned for its bold branding and cutting-edge solutions. The company specializes in developing advanced security automation platforms that leverage artificial intelligence to empower security teams across the globe. With a strong backing from Series D funding, GrabJobs has experienced remarkable growth, including a 200% increase in employee numbers and a 300% surge in revenue. The organization is recognized for its vibrant culture, forward-thinking approach, and commitment to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in cybersecurity. GrabJobs is dedicated to creating a collaborative environment where talented professionals can thrive and make a meaningful impact in the industry. About The Role GrabJobs is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join its expanding team during a pivotal growth phase. This role offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast-moving, innovative environment focused on building and maintaining scalable, reliable infrastructure for a groundbreaking AI SOC platform. As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a central role in enhancing the company's deployment processes, optimizing production environments, and empowering development teams through automation and best practices. This position is based in the United States and involves close collaboration with a global DevOps team primarily based in Israel. The ideal candidate will demonstrate independence, adaptability, and proactive problem-solving skills, thriving in a dynamic setting that values high-quality solutions and continuous improvement. Qualifications Minimum of 4+ years experience as a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), or Production Engineer. Hands-on experience managing production workloads on public cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS). Proficiency with containerization and microservices architecture, including Docker and Kubernetes. Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, with experience using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and Argo Rollouts. Strong background in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Terragrunt. Automation and scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Go. Familiarity with observability tools including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and VictoriaMetrics. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and adapt to evolving collaboration patterns across different time zones. Team-oriented mindset with curiosity, technical drive, and excellent communication skills for effective collaboration in a distributed environment. Responsibilities Champion a DevOps mindset by identifying friction points in workflows and implementing scalable automation solutions to improve reliability, delivery speed, and developer experience. Operate, monitor, and optimize production environments using infrastructure as code and modern observability tools to ensure high performance and availability. Build and maintain intuitive internal tools that empower development teams, fostering a culture of self-service within R&D. Lead end-to-end deployment processes, from architecture design to implementation, managing deployments across multiple regions and environments. Collaborate closely with the Israel-based DevOps team, maintaining clear communication, ownership, and alignment despite time zone differences. Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies and frameworks to enhance infrastructure, automation, and operational efficiency. Support incident response and troubleshooting efforts, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime. Contribute to documentation, best practices, and knowledge sharing across teams to promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Benefits GrabJobs offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes comprehensive health insurance, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. Employees have access to a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation and recognizes individual contributions. The company also provides stock options, performance bonuses, and other incentives aligned with company success. Additionally, GrabJobs promotes a healthy work-life balance, fostering a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being. Joining GrabJobs means becoming part of a fast-paced, visionary organization committed to making a significant impact in the cybersecurity landscape. Equal Opportunity GrabJobs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our goal is to foster a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best work. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and are essential to our continued success.

review_candidates.title: Desk Side Support Field Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview NSC Global is looking for Level 1 Field Service Technicians to deliver on site technical support for customer systems. The role covers on site hardware troubleshooting, repair and replacement, diagnostics, service call updates, parts handling and customer communication, in line with agreed service levels and established field service procedures. Technicians attend customer locations, validate reported faults, complete the intervention and provide accurate updates throughout. The position requires sound technical troubleshooting ability, professional communication, close adherence to process and the ability to work to deadlines driven by service level agreements. Responsibilities Attend customer sites within agreed service windows and complete each intervention to the required standard. Perform on site troubleshooting, diagnostics, hardware repair and component replacement across desktops, laptops and related client hardware. Validate warranty status, asset identification and diagnostic findings before completing any repair. Apply approved diagnostic tools and methods, including built in diagnostics, LED fault codes and structured logical troubleshooting. Confirm receipt of service calls, manage estimated arrival updates and maintain accurate records in the required systems, with arrival updates within 15 minutes and closure within 30 minutes of service completion. Generate electronic service reports through the designated field service platform and obtain customer sign off following each intervention. Reinstall BIOS, drivers and operating systems where instructed and where approved recovery media is available. Troubleshoot hardware related networking faults falling within the scope of the service call. Order additional parts through the approved process, following completion of documented troubleshooting. Collect, manage, package, label and return defective or unused parts within the required process and timescales. Keep customers informed throughout the intervention, including next steps, repeat visits and parts requirements. Escalate unusual incidents immediately, including customer dissatisfaction, damage, missing equipment, unsafe environments or any issue affecting service delivery. Comply with all electrostatic discharge, safety and documented procedural requirements, and display the required identification while on customer sites. Report process deviations and quality issues, and contribute to continuous improvement. Qualifications Experience in Level 1 technical support, field service, desktop support, break/fix support or a comparable customer facing IT support role. Sound understanding of PC, laptop and client hardware components. Working knowledge of operating systems, BIOS, drivers, hardware fault isolation and basic networking principles. Ability to follow structured diagnostic processes and document troubleshooting steps accurately. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non technical customers. Ability to work independently at customer sites while observing agreed process, safety and escalation procedures. Strong time management across appointments, travel and service level expectations. High attention to detail in ticket updates, notes, parts handling and service reporting. Fluent written and spoken knowledge of the local language of the assigned territory, sufficient for direct customer contact on site. Proficient written and spoken English, sufficient for technical documentation, service reporting and communication with the wider support organisation. A valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to customer locations. CompTIA A+ certification is desirable, particularly for technicians new to this area of client hardware support. Tools and equipment Smartphone or tablet compatible with the required field service applications. Reliable internet connectivity suitable for field service updates and application use. Access to an electrostatic discharge kit and standard computer repair tools. Bootable USB key and the tools required for system disassembly and component replacement. Own vehicle available for daily travel between customer sites, with secure storage for tools and parts. Compliance and security Successful completion of all required criminal background checks prior to attending any customer site. Authorisation to work in the assigned territory in accordance with applicable law. Completion of all required authorisations and product, security, privacy and process training before performing service calls, and maintenance of that authorisation thereafter. Training is provided. Compliance with customer site access, security, privacy, safety and conduct requirements, and with all policies relating to confidential information, customer data and incident escalation. Technicians must be free of drugs and alcohol when performing service activity.

review_candidates.title: Corporate Affairs & Government Relations Manager
review_candidates.description: Empower Capital ES is hiring a Corporate Affairs & Government Relations Manager to take ownership of the practical work required to keep our Egyptian companies and projects properly documented, licensed and moving forward. This is a hands-on execution role. We need someone who knows which documents each authority requires, prepares complete files, follows them through in person and online, resolves comments promptly, and closes each matter with the final approval or stamped document. Responsibilities • Prepare, submit and follow up on company filings and post-incorporation matters with GAFI and other relevant authorities. • Organise ordinary and extraordinary general assemblies; prepare agendas, notices, minutes and supporting documents; and follow through on GAFI review, ratification and official copies as applicable. • Coordinate amendments to company records, board resolutions, powers of attorney, commercial registry and related corporate documents with external counsel and notaries where needed. • Obtain and renew licences, permits and approvals for company operations and projects, working with GAFI’s Investor Service Centre and the competent issuing authorities. • Maintain a live register of every filing and licence, including requirements, owner, submission date, outstanding comments, deadline and final evidence of completion. • Give management concise weekly updates, flag obstacles early and recommend the next practical step. Requirements • At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Egyptian corporate filings, GAFI procedures, general assembly documentation and government licensing. • A law degree is preferred; qualified lawyers and experienced corporate affairs specialists are both welcome. Any legal representation or legal opinion must be handled by a properly authorised lawyer. • Strong working knowledge of Egyptian company documents and the ability to prepare accurate Arabic submissions. Good written and spoken English is needed for internal coordination. • Willingness to visit authorities, follow up persistently and take personal responsibility for closing files. • Organised, discreet and comfortable managing several deadlines at once. Full-time, on-site in Heliopolis, Cairo, with regular visits to government offices and project locations as needed. To apply, please submit your CV through LinkedIn and briefly describe two GAFI, general assembly or licensing matters you personally took from submission to completion.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
review_candidates.description: About Motion 💡 Motion is building the command center for creative strategists : an AI-native platform that bridges the gap between performance marketers and creative teams, so they can uncover what’s working, what’s not, and ship more winning ads across platforms like YouTube, LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok. ⁠ We're at the forefront of AI as the foundation of our product. Motion now automatically analyzes and organizes creative at scale and surfaces competitor trends. And with Runneth - the AI brain for the 100x marketer - we're going further: a persistent creative strategy agent that lives where your team already works (Slack, Notion, Google Drive, your ad data) and turns a marketer's knowledge and instincts into cross-channel playbooks, automated workflows, and a system that gets smarter over time. Our bet isn't that AI replaces great marketers. It's that the best marketers will use AI to operate at a scale that wasn't previously possible. ⁠ Today, Motion is trusted by some of the world’s top e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands and agencies (including Vuori, True Classic, The Farmer’s Dog, and HexClad) and has analyzed over $14B in media spend. When leading brands want to understand their creative performance, they turn to us. Our founders have built successful companies before, including alongside several of the people now at Motion. A number of teammates chose to build again here — a reflection of the trust, culture, and conviction behind what we’re building. The people building Motion are deeply embedded in where AI and our industry is heading, and obsessed with closing the gap between what's possible and what's actually shipping in product. We're a 75 person remote team backed by $65M+ in funding with a valuation that's nearly 3x'd in under two years. If you want to work on a hard problem, with people who've done it before, and a product that customers genuinely love - we'd love to connect! ▶️ Brief overview of the Motion product & Runneth from our Co-Founder & CEO, Reza Khadjavi. The Role Motion’s products increasingly rely on data-intensive APIs. Beyond our reporting platform, MCP server, and public endpoints, these APIs now power per-customer environments where AI systems can execute tasks, access customer-specific state, and proactively run analysis. Today, that means Azure VMs running Dockerized workloads and a growing layer of application code which needs to cover everything from functionality to routine updates. We’re looking for a senior software engineer who loves working at the boundary between product code and infrastructure. This is not a traditional DevOps or SRE role. You’ll spend most of your time writing application code that controls infrastructure primitives: messaging queue abstractions, VM management, data lifecycle, container updates, no-downtime migrations, bootstrapping, permissions, observability, and security. The right person is comfortable going deep into Linux, containers, networking, and all that jazz, but thinks like a product engineer: shipping reliable systems, choosing pragmatic abstractions, and making complicated runtime behavior feel routine to our customers. | Our tech stack : Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Azure, and Pulumi. 🔗 Explore our Engineering at Motion page to learn more about our team, our work, and how we build together. 👩‍💻 Browse our Engineering Blog for an inside look at the decisions our team is making, the things we're learning, and what it means for us to be building an AI product today. What You'd Be Doing 🛠️ Build and evolve the systems that provision, update, secure, and observe Motion’s agent environments. Design abstractions around queues, locks, background tasks, and service bus mechanics so product engineers can build on reliable primitives. Evolve our infrastructure-as-code footprint in Pulumi — defining patterns other engineers can build on. Work with Linux systems, mounted persistent storage, OS disks, container boundaries, permissions, logs, and runtime debugging. Participate in a small, high-ownership, cross-functional team with weekly cycles. Our ideal fit brings ✨ 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with meaningful time spent going deep into infrastructure. Strong production backend experience. TypeScript / Node.js is ideal, but we care more about strong engineering judgment and the ability to learn our stack quickly Deep, hands-on cloud experience. Azure is where we live, but AWS or GCP experience transfers if you are strong on the fundamentals. Fluency with infrastructure-as-code. We use Pulumi but any relevant experience in Terraform or CDK is good. Hands-on experience with containers and runtime environments. Docker is important; experience with Kubernetes, Nomad, ECS, Docker Swarm, or similar orchestration systems is helpful but not required. Experience designing reliable systems around background jobs, queues, locks, service buses, migrations, retries, and failure recovery. Strong security instincts for application runtime environments. and you'll be a strong fit if you align with these qualities: You're genuinely excited about infrastructure. When something breaks, you want to understand how the system actually works, not just scale and restart it. A strong sense of ownership: you make decisions and move quickly to fix things quickly when they go wrong. A pragmatic mindset. You can ship the simple thing when speed matters, while flagging that which needs to evolve later. Comfortable in a fast-moving startup where requirements come with ambiguity and the “right” way isn't handed to you. You enjoy being a strong individual contributor and a supportive teammate. Engineering is a team sport here 💪 What You'll Love About Motion 💜 Competitive compensation package: We offer competitive compensation, including equity for all employees, health benefits from day one, a monthly health & lifestyle stipend to support your well-being, 20 days of PTO, and a $1,500 work-from-home stipend. Remote-first with hybrid flexibility: We're a remote-first company with team members spanning Canada, the U.S., and beyond, but also have office spaces in 4 main hubs (Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, and Porto) for optional hybrid work. Growth that speaks for itself: Motion has strong product-market fit, 2.5x YoY growth, second-time founders with deep industry knowledge, and $30M in Series B funding to fuel our momentum. Opportunity for impact: As an early team member, your contributions will directly shape the product, team, and the future of the company. If you're excited about building, you’ll thrive here! Award-winning team: We're a low-ego, high-performing team that was just ranked #19 on G2's list of Best Canadian Software Companies for 2026. Team connection: Virtual: Day-to-day, we use Roam, an AI-powered virtual office platform that fosters spontaneous collaboration, drop into meetings or quick chats, and interact with colleagues for a simulated, "live" digital headquarters. In-person: Outside of the option to go to one of our offices, our team gets together in-person for a week every two months, and we have a company retreat every summer. We closed out 2024 with a $30M Series B raise and strong signals from our customers. In 2025, we built the foundational capabilities our customers rely on, setting the stage for what's to come. In 2026, with fresh funding ($65M+ total capital raised), we’re building forward from that foundation, taking what we learned to market in a deeply AI-native way. 🌎 A note on location : we're looking to hire someone based in Canada, the United States, or Europe but are open to exceptional candidates in other locations. If this position excites you and you believe you'd be a strong fit, we encourage you to apply! We use artificial intelligence (AI) in certain parts of our recruiting process at Motion, ranging from administrative and efficiency-focused support to, in some cases, conducting introductory interviews. Every AI interview is reviewed, and every hiring decision is made, by a (human) member of our team.
